title: BJBS/AK VEF clinch U19 League title
description: Edvards Egle (190-2005) stepped up and scored 21 points, 7 rebounds and 6 assists for the winners and Rudolfs Svitins (200-2005) chipped in 16 points and 7 rebounds. Four BJBS/AK VEF players scored in double figures. At the losing side guard Janis Censonis (185-2005) responded with 20 points, 6 rebounds and 5 assists and guard Krisjanis Petersons (190-2006) scored 22 points and 7 rebounds. Ventspils Spars: P.Krisjanis 22+7reb+2ast, C.Janis 20+6reb+5ast, S.Toms 17+6reb+3ast, D.Rudis 6+9reb+1ast, B.Ricards 3+2reb, L.Markuss 2+1ast
